attendance_mail_claim_ck.name: attendance_mail_claim_ck
attendance_mail_claim_ck.value: ("attendance_mail"."claim_token" is null and "attendance_mail"."claimed_at" is null) or ("attendance_mail"."claim_token" is not null and "attendance_mail"."claimed_at" is not null)

attendance_mail_sending_ck.name: attendance_mail_sending_ck
attendance_mail_sending_ck.value: "attendance_mail"."status" <> 'sending' or ("attendance_mail"."claim_token" is not null and "attendance_mail"."recipient" is not null)

attendance_questions_activity_ck.name: attendance_questions_activity_ck
attendance_questions_activity_ck.value: ("attendance_questions"."active" = 1 and "attendance_questions"."inactive_reason" is null and "attendance_questions"."canonical_question_id" is null) or ("attendance_questions"."active" = 0 and "attendance_questions"."inactive_reason" is not null)

attendance_questions_automatic_ck.name: attendance_questions_automatic_ck
attendance_questions_automatic_ck.value: ("attendance_questions"."kind" = 'automatic-out' and "attendance_questions"."open_entry_id" is not null and "attendance_questions"."automatic_entry_id" is not null and json_array_length("attendance_questions"."missing_kinds") = 0) or ("attendance_questions"."kind" = 'missing-times' and "attendance_questions"."automatic_entry_id" is null and json_array_length("attendance_questions"."missing_kinds") > 0)

attendance_source_state_shape_ck.name: attendance_source_state_shape_ck
attendance_source_state_shape_ck.value: ("attendance_source_state"."record_kind" = 'scan' and "attendance_source_state"."generation" is not null and "attendance_source_state"."cursor" is not null and "attendance_source_state"."endpoint" is not null and "attendance_source_state"."completed" is not null and "attendance_source_state"."cursor" >= 0 and "attendance_source_state"."endpoint" >= 0 and "attendance_source_state"."cursor" <= "attendance_source_state"."endpoint") or ("attendance_source_state"."record_kind" = 'watch' and "attendance_source_state"."generation" is null and "attendance_source_state"."cursor" is null and "attendance_source_state"."endpoint" is null and "attendance_source_state"."completed" is null)

pay_period_closures_predecessor_ck.name: pay_period_closures_predecessor_ck
pay_period_closures_predecessor_ck.value:
("pay_period_closures"."sequence_no" = 1 and "pay_period_closures"."prev_closure_hash" is null)
  or ("pay_period_closures"."sequence_no" > 1 and "pay_period_closures"."prev_closure_hash" is not null)

pay_period_settings_anchor_ck.name: pay_period_settings_anchor_ck
pay_period_settings_anchor_ck.value:
("pay_period_settings"."frequency" <> 'fortnightly' and "pay_period_settings"."anchor_date" is null)
    or ("pay_period_settings"."frequency" = 'fortnightly' and "pay_period_settings"."anchor_date" is not null
      and date("pay_period_settings"."anchor_date", '+0 days') is not null
      and date("pay_period_settings"."anchor_date", '+0 days') = "pay_period_settings"."anchor_date" and strftime('%w', "pay_period_settings"."anchor_date") = '1')

time_entries_author_ck.name: time_entries_author_ck
time_entries_author_ck.value:
coalesce(("time_entries"."author_kind" = 'automatic' and "time_entries"."recorded_by_person_id" is null)
      or ("time_entries"."author_kind" is null and "time_entries"."recorded_by_person_id" is not null)
      or ("time_entries"."author_kind" in ('worker','manager') and "time_entries"."recorded_by_person_id" is not null), 0)

time_entries_correction_shape_ck.name: time_entries_correction_shape_ck
time_entries_correction_shape_ck.value:
("time_entries"."author_kind" is null and "time_entries"."correction_direction" is null
          and "time_entries"."missing_entry_kind" is null and "time_entries"."responds_to_entry_id" is null
          and "time_entries"."pay_period_closure_id" is null
          and "time_entries"."entry_kind" <> 'confirmation'
          and (("time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is null and "time_entries"."correction_reason" is null
            and "time_entries"."correction_status" is null and "time_entries"."correction_actor_id" is null)
            or ("time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is not null and "time_entries"."correction_reason" is not null
            and "time_entries"."correction_status" is not null and "time_entries"."correction_actor_id" is not null)))
        or ("time_entries"."entry_kind" in ('in','out','break_start','break_end')
          and "time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is null and "time_entries"."correction_reason" is null
          and "time_entries"."correction_status" is null and "time_entries"."correction_actor_id" is null
          and "time_entries"."correction_direction" is null and "time_entries"."missing_entry_kind" is null
          and "time_entries"."responds_to_entry_id" is null and "time_entries"."pay_period_closure_id" is null)
        or ("time_entries"."entry_kind" = 'confirmation' and "time_entries"."responds_to_entry_id" is not null
          and "time_entries"."author_kind" is not null
          and (("time_entries"."author_kind" = 'worker' and "time_entries"."pay_period_closure_id" is null)
            or ("time_entries"."author_kind" = 'automatic' and "time_entries"."pay_period_closure_id" is not null))
          and "time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is null and "time_entries"."correction_reason" is null
          and "time_entries"."correction_status" is null and "time_entries"."correction_actor_id" is null
          and "time_entries"."correction_direction" is null and "time_entries"."missing_entry_kind" is null)
        or ("time_entries"."entry_kind" = 'correction' and "time_entries"."correction_reason" is not null
          and "time_entries"."correction_status" is not null and "time_entries"."correction_actor_id" is not null
          and "time_entries"."pay_period_closure_id" is null
          and (("time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is not null and "time_entries"."missing_entry_kind" is null)
            or ("time_entries"."corrects_entry_id" is null and "time_entries"."missing_entry_kind" is not null
              and "time_entries"."correction_direction" is not null and "time_entries"."author_kind" is not null)))

time_entries_chaining_ck.name: time_entries_chaining_ck
time_entries_chaining_ck.value:
("time_entries"."is_first_entry" and "time_entries"."prev_entry_hash" is null)
          or (not "time_entries"."is_first_entry" and "time_entries"."prev_entry_hash" is not null)

workforce_chains_pointer_ck.name: workforce_chains_pointer_ck
workforce_chains_pointer_ck.value:
("workforce_chains"."last_entry_id" is null) = ("workforce_chains"."last_entry_hash" is null)
          and ("workforce_chains"."last_entry_id" is null) = ("workforce_chains"."last_recorded_at" is null)
